lines.text: Nineteen tools, filed by what you are trying to do.
Capture, Check, Design and Break: the four things you are trying to do.
Simple shows the five a first day needs. Expert shows all of them.
Every one of them works on the page you are standing on, logged in and mid-flow.
Whatever you press, the finding lands in the same report.
The meter beside each group answers what a list cannot: what you have not done.
Four films, one for each group, go through them one at a time.

lines.delivery: warm, unhurried, final. Not a sell

voice.note: The commercial's final recipe: one Gemini request per line, one voice and one delivery instruction, the gate selecting by shot fit among contour-passing draws, the clean chain with a +6 dB bell at 3.9 kHz whose gain is inside the voice trim.
